cards.ex: He always looks so well-groomed, even on casual Fridays.
cards.exUz: U har doim juda ozoda ko'rinadi, hatto oddiy juma kunlarida ham.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga qaragan, sochlari va kiyimlari tartibli bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: We should dress up for the party tonight.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun ziyofatga chiroyli kiyinishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy kundagidan ko'ra chiroyli va rasmiy kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: She decided to get a new haircut and try a new look.
cards.exUz: U yangi soch turmagini olishga va yangi qiyofa sinab ko'rishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zining tashqi ko'rinishini o'zgartirish, yangi uslub yaratish.

cards.ex: I've put on weight since I started working from home.
cards.exUz: Men uyda ishlay boshlaganimdan beri semirib ketdim.
cards.uzDef: Vazni oshib ketmoq, tana massasi ko'paymoq.

cards.ex: He's trying to lose weight before his wedding.
cards.exUz: U to'yidan oldin ozishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Vazni kamaymoq, tana massasini kamaytirmoq.

cards.ex: She looks young for her age.
cards.exUz: U yoshiga nisbatan yosh ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z yoshidan kichikroq ko'rinishga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Stress can make you look old.
cards.exUz: Stress sizni qaritishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'z yoshidan katta ko'rinishga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: It's a casual office, so you can dress down.
cards.exUz: Bu oddiy ofis, shuning uchun siz oddiy kiyinishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy emas, balki oddiy kiyim kiyish.

cards.ex: She's fair-skinned and burns easily in the sun.
cards.exUz: U oq terili va quyoshda oson yonadi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiq rangli teriga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: He's dark-skinned and tans easily.
cards.exUz: U qora terili va oson bronzlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Qora rangli teriga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She went to a salon to get a makeover.
cards.exUz: U tashqi ko'rinishini o'zgartirish uchun salonga bordi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishini butunlay o'zgartirish, yangi stil yaratish.

cards.ex: I'm growing out my hair.
cards.exUz: Men sochlarimni o'stirmoqdaman.
cards.uzDef: Sochni qisqa muddatdan uzunroq qilish jarayoni.

cards.ex: My grandfather is 80, but he's still fit as a fiddle.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 80 yoshda, lekin u hali ham juda sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va kuchli bo'lish.

cards.ex: I love your outfit, where did you get it?
cards.exUz: Sizning kiyimingiz menga juda yoqdi, uni qayerdan oldingiz?
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda kiyiladigan kiyimlar to'plami.

cards.ex: She was dressed to kill for her date.
cards.exUz: U uchrashuvga juda chiroyli kiyingan edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda chiroyli va jozibali kiyingan.

cards.ex: She always looks perfect, not a hair out of place.
cards.exUz: U har doim mukammal ko'rinadi, sochlari doim joyida.
cards.term: not a hair out of place
cards.uzDef: Sochi juda tartibli va mukammal ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Her dress was so stunning, it really turned heads.
cards.exUz: Uning libosi juda ajoyib edi, u haqiqatan ham odamlarning e'tiborini tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Go'zalligi yoki uslubi bilan odamlarning e'tiborini jalb qilish.

cards.ex: She has a glow about her since she started her new job.
cards.exUz: U yangi ishga kirgandan beri yuzidan nur sochib yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lom va baxtli ko'rinish, yuzidan nur taralishi.

cards.ex: She's aging gracefully and looks wonderful.
cards.exUz: U chiroyli qarimoqda va ajoyib ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Qarilik belgilarini qabul qilib, o'ziga g'amxo'rlik qilib qarish.

cards.ex: He may be rough around the edges, but he has a good heart.
cards.exUz: U biroz qo'pol bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uning yuragi yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishi va xulq-atvorida kamchiliklari bor.

cards.ex: Knowing your body type can help you choose the right clothes.
cards.exUz: Tana tuzilishingizni bilish to'g'ri kiyimlarni tanlashga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Odamning tana shakli va tuzilishi.

cards.ex: He looked scruffy after camping for a week.
cards.exUz: U bir hafta chodirda yashagandan keyin betartib ko'rindi.
cards.uzDef: Tartibsiz va ozoda bo'lmagan tashqi ko'rinish.

cards.ex: She always looks so put-together, even when she's just running errands.
cards.exUz: U doim juda uyg'un ko'rinadi, hatto shunchaki yumushlar bilan shug'ullanayotgan bo'lsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli, tartibli va o'ziga ishongan ko'rinish.

cards.ex: We're going out tonight, so I need to get dolled up.
cards.exUz: Biz bugun kechqurun chiqamiz, shuning uchun men bezanishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli kiyim kiyish va makiyaj qilish.

cards.ex: She's a plain-looking girl, but she has a great personality.
cards.exUz: U oddiy ko'rinishli qiz, lekin uning shaxsiyati ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Unchalik chiroyli emas, oddiy ko'rinishga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She has striking features, like her bright blue eyes.
cards.exUz: Uning yorqin ko'k ko'zlari kabi ajoyib xususiyatlari bor.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni tortadigan, unutilmas yuz xususiyatlari.

cards.ex: She always looks effortlessly chic, even in jeans and a t-shirt.
cards.exUz: U doim o'ziga xos ko'rinadi, hatto jinsi va futbolkada ham.
cards.uzDef: Harakat qilmasdan, tabiiy ravishda zamonaviy va chiroyli ko'rinish.

cards.ex: Her beauty made me do a double take.
cards.exUz: Uning go'zalligi meni hayratdan qotirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ajablanarli yoki qiziqarli narsani ko'rib, ikki marta qarash.

cards.ex: She's a little on the plump side, but she's very healthy.
cards.exUz: U biroz to'laroq, lekin u juda sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Ortiqcha vaznga ega, semizga yaqin.

cards.ex: She has a slender figure.
cards.exUz: Uning ingichka qomati bor.
cards.uzDef: Nozik va ingichka tana tuzilishiga ega bo'lgan odam.
